what: This site maps a short list of tumour gene findings to approved drugs and recruiting trials, from public sources only.
It is general information. It is not medical advice, a diagnosis or a treatment recommendation.
intro.how: Pick a gene finding. You will see a decision tree: cancer type, then the gene change, then when a drug is used. Tags are Mainstream, Trials, or On the edge. Order is not a ranking. Talk to your oncologist.
